notStarted.label: Not started
notStarted.reason: This Feature is New and does not have associated Stories or Bugs yet.
notStarted.recommendedAction: Confirm when discovery and delivery planning should begin.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.reason: The Target Date has passed and one or more Stories or Bugs are still in progress.
overdue.recommendedAction: Review active delivery work, remaining scope, dependencies, and Target Date.

targetDateNearUnscheduledDiscovery.label: Target date near
targetDateNearUnscheduledDiscovery.reasonTemplate: {count} Discovery work item(s) are not assigned to a Sprint, and the Target Date is within the next two weeks.
targetDateNearUnscheduledDiscovery.recommendedAction: Assign the remaining Discovery work to a Sprint and confirm the delivery plan.

targetNextMonthWithoutRelease.label: Target date next month — no Release Fix Version
targetNextMonthWithoutRelease.reason: The Target Date falls in the next calendar month, but no Release Fix Version is defined.
targetNextMonthWithoutRelease.recommendedAction: Define the Release Fix Version and confirm release alignment.

closedWithOpenWork.label: Closed w/open work
closedWithOpenWork.reason: The Feature is Closed, but associated delivery work is still in planning or in progress.
closedWithOpenWork.recommendedAction: Reconcile the Feature status with the remaining Stories and Bugs requiring delivery work.

needsEstimate.label: Needs estimate
needsEstimate.reason: The Feature is Planned or In Process and does not have BE, FE, or QA estimates.
needsEstimate.recommendedAction: Add BE, FE, or QA estimates before continuing delivery planning.

noStories.label: No Stories
noStories.reason: This Feature is in delivery execution but has no associated Stories or Bugs.
noStories.recommendedAction: Create or link the Stories and Bugs required to deliver this Feature.

noActiveWork.label: No active work
noActiveWork.reason: There is open delivery work, but no Story or Bug is currently active.
noActiveWork.recommendedAction: Confirm the next Story or Bug entering active development.

unestimatedWork.label: No estimated work
unestimatedWork.reasonTemplate: {count} associated work item(s) do not have an estimate.
unestimatedWork.recommendedAction: Estimate the open Stories or Bugs that require Story Points.

healthy.label: Healthy
healthy.reason: No delivery execution risks were detected.
healthy.recommendedAction: Continue monitoring delivery progress and planned milestones.

unableToEvaluate.label: Unable to evaluate
unableToEvaluate.reason: Delivery work information could not be retrieved.
unableToEvaluate.recommendedAction: Refresh the dashboard and verify Azure DevOps availability and work-item relationships.

releaseAlignmentAtRisk.label: Release alignment at risk
releaseAlignmentAtRisk.reasonTemplate: {count} open work item(s) are not aligned with the Sprint and Release Fix Version required for {rfv}.
releaseAlignmentAtRisk.recommendedAction: Assign the remaining work to the Sprint planned for this release, align the Story or Bug Release Fix Version, or move the Feature to the next viable Release Fix Version.

releaseCommitmentMissed.label: Release commitment missed
releaseCommitmentMissed.reasonTemplate: The Sprint commitment cutoff for {rfv} has passed and {count} open work item(s) are not aligned with the planned release.
releaseCommitmentMissed.recommendedAction: Move the Feature and affected work items to the next viable Release Fix Version and update the delivery plan.

releaseDatePassedWithOpenWork.label: Release date passed
releaseDatePassedWithOpenWork.reasonTemplate: The release date for {rfv} has passed and {count} delivery work item(s) remain pending.
releaseDatePassedWithOpenWork.recommendedAction: Reconcile the Feature Release Fix Version, delivery status, and next release plan.

releaseAlignmentUnavailable.label: Release alignment unavailable
releaseAlignmentUnavailable.reason: The Feature has a Release Fix Version, but the required Sprint or release planning data is unavailable.
releaseAlignmentUnavailable.recommendedAction: Update the release planning calendar and verify the Feature, Story, and Bug Release Fix Version values.
